value.rationale: The original published algebraic property merely requires one witness per ordered pair. This supplies a sharp uniform ambient density 1/8, exact nontrivial 4-level two-vertex neighborhood-difference spectrum across an infinite family, six extremizers, and exponential concentration at ambient density 1/4. This natural quantified robustness is mathematically relevant to the strength of the published counterexamples.
